section_d_contract_loss.text_field_dropped_at_export: YES -- ROOT CAUSE. A/C's results.jsonl result-item schema (both pre- and post-reformat) never carries a 'text'/'chunk_text' field -- only chunk_text_sha256 (a deliberate non-leak design for the git-committed artifact from an earlier turn). B/D's own results.jsonl result items DO carry a real 'text' field (verified: 126-char sample). fourarm.py's check_locators() (line 323-327) reads `r.get('text')` directly off the result item -- NOT from the NodeStore -- as its first content-verification gate: `if not text: severity=unresolved, reason=no_text_to_verify`. Because A/C's result items never populate 'text', literally every slot-match candidate fails this gate before the scorer ever reaches its own NodeStore-based text comparison (line 328, store.fetch_node) -- the exact mechanism that works correctly for B/D. This is a single, uniform, 100%-reproducing cause: {'no_text_to_verify': 229} / {'no_text_to_verify': 216} show reason=no_text_to_verify for literally every A/C unresolved packet, and chunk_text is empty in 0/229 (A) and 0/216 (C) cases -- i.e. always.
section_d_contract_loss.recall_metrics_unaffected: Recall@k/found_at/all_found_at/doc_hit_at are computed by slot_found() (fourarm.py:171-228), which treats a text-less match as span_state='blind' (line 202-203) and still counts it as found via doc_id+node membership alone -- so A/C's reported Recall numbers are NOT contaminated by this defect. Only the separate check_locators() pass (which classifies each match as critical/minor/unresolved for the hard/quality gate) is blind.

NOT performed in this turn (retrieval/scoring rerun is out of scope); whether reconstructed text would actually resolve each packet to verified/critical/minor is unknown without an actual rescoring pass, which this turn does not run.
